name: Bodyweight Russian Twist
cardText:
Bodyweight Russian Twist
Beginner
1
Hover your heels just off the ground.
2
Stick your chest out and maintain a flat back. Make all the movement happen at your mid and upper spine.
3
Point your chest to the left, then rotate at the spine until your chest is pointed right.

name: Side Plank Up Down
cardText:
Side Plank Up Down
Intermediate
1
Start with your elbow and hip on the ground. Either neutral fist or flat hand on the ground.
2
Begin in a side plank position, and then drop your hips to the floor.
3
Pull your hips back to the ceiling to finish the rep.

name: Side Plank Reach Through
cardText:
Side Plank Reach Through
Advanced
1
Begin in an elbow side plank position.
2
Reach for the ceiling with your off hand.
3
Rotate at the mid and upper spine and reach through the open space between the floor and your torso.
4
Reach backwards, and then rotate back into the starting position.

name: Elbow Side Plank
cardText:
Elbow Side Plank
Novice
1
Press your elbow into the floor.
2
Pick your hips up off the ground and maintain this position for the allotted amount of time.
3
Make sure you don't let your chest fall forward or backward.

name: Hand Side Plank
cardText:
Hand Side Plank
Beginner
1
Press your hand into the ground and pick up your hip off the ground.
2
Open your chest and maintain this position for the allotted amount of time.

name: Hand Side Plank Reach Through
cardText:
Hand Side Plank Reach Through
Advanced
1
Start in a side plank position.
2
Reach your top arm under your body.
3
Return to the plank position.

name: Alternating Heel Touch
cardText:
Alternating Heel Touch
Novice
1
Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
2
Reach right hand to right heel.
3
Switch sides, left hand to left heel. Repeat.

name: Oblique Crunch
cardText:
Oblique Crunch
Beginner
1
Lie on your side, knees bent, hands behind head.
2
Bring your elbow towards your knees and flex your obliques.

name: Oblique Jackknife
cardText:
Oblique Jackknife
Intermediate
1
Lie on your side, legs straight, hand behind head.
2
Lift both legs and upper body simultaneously.
3
Squeeze obliques, then lower back down. Repeat on both sides.

name: Reach And Catch
cardText:
Reach And Catch
Novice
1
Lay flat on your back with both hands over one leg.
2
Reach toward your knee flexing your abs and obliques.
3
Do the prescribed amount of reps, then switch sides.

name: Windshield Wiper
cardText:
Windshield Wiper
Intermediate
1
Lie on back, arms out, legs together.
2
Lift legs to 90 degrees.
3
Rotate legs side to side, keeping shoulders grounded.

name: Bodyweight Thoracic Spine Rotation
cardText:
Bodyweight Thoracic Spine Rotation
Novice
1
Start on all fours then bring your chest to the ground. Place one hand on the ground in front of you. The other hand behind your head/ear.
2
On the side of the hand that is behind your head, rotate until your elbow is pointed at the ceiling and then hold this position.

name: Stability Ball Side Crunch
cardText:
Stability Ball Side Crunch
Beginner
1
Lie sideways on a stability ball, feet anchored, hands behind head, core engaged.
2
Crunch sideways by contracting obliques, bringing your upper body toward your hip.

name: Bodyweight Feet Down Russian Twist
cardText:
Bodyweight Feet Down Russian Twist
Novice
1
Sit with feet on floor, lean back slightly, and clasp hands at chest.
2
Rotate torso to one side without lifting feet.
3
Twist to opposite side, keeping core tight and movement controlled.
